# Jigsaw

Welcome to **Jigsaw Puzzles for Archipelago**, where every piece is a *peace* of the action! 🧩

You're about to *assemble* your way to glory in the most *edge-of-your-seat* experience ever! Here's how it all *fits together*:

- You’ll receive puzzle pieces – no need to *corner* the market, they’ll come to you.  
- Start *connecting the dots* (well, edges), and *lock* in checks as you *snap* your progress into place.  
- When all the pieces *click*, you’ll *frame* a beautiful victory and *complete the picture*.

It’s not just a game — it’s a *re-piece-ening*!  
So don’t *fall to pieces* — *stick with it*, and you’ll *piece* the whole thing together.

Now go on — *edge out* the competition, *slot into* puzzle mode, and *shape up* for a brainy blast!

notes.text:
# Version 0.10.0
A new version thanks to the amazing work of @djfariel <3
- **_Huge media upgrade_**: GIF support, camera input (including OBS Studio virtual camera), and live YouTube/Twitch browser capture — your puzzle can now be almost anything.
- Major engine overhaul: New accelerated WebGL-style renderer, support for up to 2500 pieces (solo play on the beta site only), smoother performance, smarter aspect-ratio scaling, and a precision drop-location handle.
- Expanded controls & cosmetics: Deep zoom/pan options plus a fully upgraded visual customization panel for board look, rendering, scaling, and more.
- See the changelog in-game for all changes.

### Apworld
- Not many changes (same yaml), just some extra explanation and added **fariel** to the list of authors.
